name: app-ui-building-blocks-health-cards-nav-and-chips-sheet
title: UI Building Blocks Sheet for a Health App
whatItIs: A pale sheet titled UI Building Blocks with a headline and a grid of components: metric cards (calories, heart rate, water, sleep, walking, weight), a large heart-rate chart, three nav bar states with a black active tab, an ask-anything input, suggestion chips, greeting pill and round icon buttons.
whatItMeans: Showing all pieces with their states proves consistency, and one chart style per metric keeps each card clear.
techniques: Three nav states with the black pill moving
Each metric with its own mini chart
Dashed outline grouping the nav variants

vocabulary.definition: A version of a navigation bar with a different active tab.
A card showing one measure with a small chart.
Reusable UI pieces that make up screens.
